articles.summary: PLANO, Texas (Nov. 5, 2026) – The 2027 Toyota Tundra is set to level up its game with an array of exciting updates and enhancements designed to elevate style, capability, and the everyday driving experience. With a perfect blend of rugged performance, luxurious comfort, and advanced technology, the Tundra continues to be a top choice for drivers seeking a no-compromise full-size pickup. For 2027, Tundra brings a refreshed exterior, the introduction of the overlanding-ready Trailhunter package, upgraded TRD Pro suspension, and significant enhancements in towing technology. Expected to arrive at dealerships in the fall of 2026, the newest Tundra will have a starting MSRP of $42,890.
articles.title: 2027 Toyota Tundra: A Bold New Chapter in Full-Size Pickup Excellence with Advanced Towing Tech and the New Trailhunter Package

articles.summary: PLANO, Texas (Nov. 5, 2026) – Today, Toyota Motor North America (TMNA) announced a leadership transition effective January 1, 2027. Ted Ogawa, TMNA’s president and chief executive officer, will return to Toyota Motor Corporation (TMC) in Japan as Senior Fellow. In this role, he will oversee external affairs activities for some Toyota-owned businesses.
articles.title: Toyota Motor North America (TMNA) Announces Executive Leadership Transition

articles.summary: PLANO, Texas (Nov. 4, 2026) – Toyota is taking its flagship full-size SUV to uncharted territory for the 2027 model year. The 2027 Toyota Sequoia arrives with a bolder exterior, the highly anticipated introduction of the rugged Trailhunter package, and a massive leap forward in towing intelligence. Engineered for modern families who refuse to compromise on luxury, interior space, or genuine off-road capability, the updated Sequoia is ready to conquer your next escape, from the daily school commute to remote, off-the-grid campsites. The updated Sequoia will have a starting MSRP of $69,900 and is expected to arrive at dealerships in the fall of 2026.
articles.title: 2027 Toyota Sequoia: Forging New Paths with the First-Ever Sequoia Trailhunter, Upgraded TRD Pro, and Next-Generation Towing Technology

articles.summary: PLANO, Texas (Nov. 5, 2026) — The 2027 RAV4 remains Toyota’s benchmark small SUV, offering a fully electrified lineup in a choice of HEV and PHEV powertrains, available FWD or AWD, and a broad range of grades tailored to different driving lifestyles. It continues the momentum of the sixth-generation model while adding two notable updates for the new model year: a revised suspension for the RAV4 Woodland grade, pushing ground clearance up to 9.1-inches, and the addition of a NACS port for all PHEV grades.
articles.title: 2027 Toyota RAV4 Builds on a Fully Electrified Formula with New Woodland Capability and Expanded Charging Convenience
